_note: The euro. Every EU member in this roster is a euro member and neither non-EU neighbour is, so its member set equals the EU's -- that is the roster rather than a shortcut, and a V3.3 tranche that brings a non-euro EU member (DNK, ... or the states) will make the two sets diverge in data, which is the point of a register. Ships zero-priced on purpose: a currency union has no machinery behind it yet, and pricing one with no measurement is exactly the invented number this project refuses. The named trigger for pricing it: a session that wants the euro to DO something owes a measured band (inflation or credit channels are the candidates) and a BALANCE_PLAN pre-declaration.
name: The Eurozone
summary: The countries that gave up their own currencies. One interest rate, one exchange rate, and a shared stake in each other's debts.
